role: Meta-cognitive performance tracking and self-awareness substrate for Co-Being across three domains: mathematics, morphology, and semantic reasoning.
detail: MetacognitiveAnalyzer is the main service class providing read-only query of the knowledge graph to identify performance patterns, strengths, and weaknesses. Key methods: analyze_math_performance() queries COMPUTES_TO and DOES_NOT_COMPUTE_TO edges grouped by operation type; analyze_morphology_performance() queries TRANSFORMS_TO edges grouped by transform_type; analyze_reasoning_performance() queries SemanticInferenceTrace nodes grouped by query_type. identify_weak_areas() flags operations below accuracy threshold (0.80), with declining confidence, or with error_count > 2. calibrate_confidence() compares predicted confidence vs actual accuracy with 0.10 tolerance. generate_full_report() synthesizes all domains into CognitivePerformanceReport. Data classes: OperationStats (per-operation metrics), DomainPerformanceReport (per-domain aggregate), WeakArea (flagged underperformance), CalibrationReport (confidence alignment analysis). All operations are graph-read-only with no mutations or LLM calls. CANON A.19 compliance: procedural self-awareness substrate.
